title: Paper Coach Tutorial
description: A stroke-by-stroke drawing tutorial. Shared verbatim with the iOS player: both apps must accept exactly the same documents.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within a tutorial library.

title.description: Human-readable name of the whole drawing.

steps.description: Ordered steps. The player pauses after each one.

canvas.description: Coordinate space for every stroke coordinate and line width. Maps directly to the SVG viewBox.

color.description: Hex colour. Matches what the iOS Color(hex:) initialiser accepts: #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA, with the leading # optional. Three-digit #RGB is NOT accepted, because iOS would silently fall back to the default instead of drawing it.

instruction.description: Shown to the child while they copy the step onto paper.

voiceover.description: Reserved for a future version. Always null in v1; players ignore it.

strokes.description: Drawn strictly in order; stroke N+1 starts when N finishes.

d.description: SVG path data, absolute M/L/C/Q/Z only.

duration.description: Seconds to draw this stroke at 1x speed.
